description: Avoid single-character variable names — they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Validate and sanitize all external input before using it
Avoid N+1 queries; batch or join related lookups
Separate business logic from I/O and framework-specific code
Keep functions short and focused on a single responsibility
Reuse compiled regexes and other expensive objects instead of rebuilding them each call
Handle errors explicitly; never silently swallow exceptions
